snippet.title: Woochi the Wayfarer - Official Reveal Trailer (Korean Dub)
snippet.description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Woochi the Wayfarer, an upcoming Korean action-adventure game developed by Nexon Games. Players will explore a fantasy world during Korea’s Joseon era as the Dosa named Jeon Woochi, the Mage of the Way. Make use of the formidable powers and abilities to fight back against injustice and trick the corrupt for good, among traditional music and monsters from Korean mythology. Woochi the Wayfarer is coming soon to consoles and PC.
